subject: incubator + cmmc pages are stale vs their generators (separate reviewable regen)
description:
Running placement-recommender/incubator-generator/new-hub-builder during the #238 scanner work regenerated 15 student-facing pages (_app/houses/*/incubator/, shield/compliance/cmmc/) with ~1980 insertions / 949 deletions -- including CSS the committed versions lack, so the live pages predate the current generator. That is a real drift worth fixing, but it is NOT part of the scanner change and must not ride along unreviewed: the incubator pages are student-facing. Regenerated copies preserved at scratchpad/incubator-regen-2026-07-28/. To do: regenerate deliberately, diff what students would see, Nancy+Chris, ship on its own.
[2026-07-31 11:38] DONE 2026-07-31. Regenerated deliberately, on its own, with pre-regen pages archived. Nancy BLOCKED the first attempt and was right: the additive merge dropped href on every carried-forward card (BUG-062) -- and it was ALREADY live, shield serving 108 dead links of 111 on production. Fixed by resolving carried-forward hrefs from the previous file's rendered anchors, falling back to ContentCatalog. Nancy then PROCEEDed with a condition, which widened again: 6 shield cards had real-looking hrefs pointing at nonexistent files; the real scope is 45 'coming-soon' catalog entries (forge 24, shield 17, script 2, key 1, code 1) that ALL have hrefs resolving to nothing on disk. Gated the new-match path on status rather than filing 6 cards. Also hard-failed the ContentCatalog fallback so a future parse failure cannot silently recreate BUG-062. FINAL, verified against the FILESYSTEM (not against '#'): cloud 32/32, dark-arts 76/76, script 157/157, shield 167/167, web 74/74 -- 506 cards, 0 that 404. NOT DEPLOYED.
